title: Syrian Vegetarian Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic vegetarian stew inspired by Syrian cuisine, made with tender vegetables and a rich spice blend.
instructions: Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large tagine or Dutch oven.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots, bell pepper, and zucchini. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the crushed tomatoes, Syrian tagine spice blend, minced garlic, salt, and chopped cilantro.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
